items.title: Vedana debuts with $46m to progress migraine therapies
items.summary: Vedana’s clinical pipeline targets PACAP – an approach that has shown varying levels of success in migraine clinical trials thus far.

items.title: AI platforms grow to improve pharma’s regulatory workflows
items.summary: Pharma is employing AI to support approval submissions by predicting how regulators will react before data is submitted.

items.title: AviadoBio broadens vMiX gene silencing licence with King’s College London
items.summary: AviadoBio has extended its exclusive licence agreement with King’s College London to apply the vMiX RNAi gene-silencing platform across all human therapeutic areas.

items.title: EHA26: BMS touts positive multiple myeloma data for two pipeline candidates
items.summary: BMS shared Phase III data for mezigdomide and Phase I data for a CAR-T therapy at this year’s EHA conference.

items.title: Altaris to acquire Simulations Plus in $375m all-cash deal
items.summary: Simulations Plus has entered a definitive agreement to be acquired by affiliates of Altaris in an all-cash transaction valued at $375m.
